input: Find an adaptive sports league for my disabled cousin

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Adaptive sports vary enormously — wheelchair basketball, para-swimming, blind football, seated volleyball, etc. Knowing which sport(s) the cousin is interested in narrows the search dramatically.
The nature and degree of the cousin's disability determines which leagues and classifications they are eligible for, and what physical accommodations are required.
Leagues are geographically bound. Without knowing the city, region, or country, it is impossible to find a locally accessible option.
Age determines whether to look for youth, adult, or senior adaptive leagues, which are run by completely different organizations.
Some leagues have registration fees, require equipment, or meet at times that may conflict with the cousin's schedule. Knowing hard limits prevents recommending inaccessible options.
The cousin may prioritize competitive play vs. recreational/social participation, which points to very different types of leagues and commitment levels.
The user's role matters — are they just finding a name and link, or are they expected to research schedules, make contact, and handle registration on the cousin's behalf?

gold.taskTitle: Find an adaptive sports league for cousin
gold.taskDescription: Research and identify a suitable adaptive sports league that fits the cousin's disability, location, interests, and availability.

questions.title: What sport or activity is your cousin interested in?
questions.description: Identify the specific sport or type of physical activity the cousin wants to play (e.g., basketball, swimming, tennis, cycling, or open to suggestions).

questions.title: What type or degree of disability does your cousin have?
questions.description: Understand the nature of the disability (e.g., mobility impairment, visual impairment, hearing impairment, intellectual disability) to match eligible leagues and classifications.

questions.title: What city or region does your cousin live in?
questions.description: Establish the geographic location to search for locally accessible leagues and facilities.

questions.title: How old is your cousin?
questions.description: Determine the age group (child, teen, adult, senior) to target the appropriate league tier and organization.

questions.title: Are there budget or scheduling limits to keep in mind?
questions.description: Identify any hard constraints such as cost of registration or equipment, or days and times that are unavailable.

questions.title: Is your cousin looking for competitive or recreational play?
questions.description: Clarify whether the priority is serious competition and skill development, or casual social and fitness-focused participation.

questions.title: How far should this research go — just a shortlist, or full sign-up help?
questions.description: Define what 'done' looks like — whether the task ends at finding a list of options, or includes contacting the league, checking schedules, and walking through registration.
